title: Compatible diagonal bases for a full-rank submodule over a PID
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative principal ideal domain, let $M$ be an $R$-module with a basis indexed by a finite set $I$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module], and let $N$ be a submodule with $\operatorname{finrank}_R N=\operatorname{finrank}_R M$. There are bases $(e_i)_{i\in I}$ of $M$, $(v_i)_{i\in I}$ of $N$, and scalars $a_i\in R$ such that the inclusion sends $v_i$ to $a_i e_i$. A principal ideal domain means a commutative ring with $1\ne0$, no zero divisors and every ideal principal.

theorem Submodule.exists_smith_normal_form_of_rank_eq
    {ι : Type*} {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [IsDomain R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] {N : Submodule R M} [Finite ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (h : Module.finrank R N = Module.finrank R M) :
    ∃ (b' : Module.Basis ι R M) (a : ι → R) (ab' : Module.Basis ι R N),
      ∀ i, (ab' i : M) = a i • b' i
